'''Sola Naberrie''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. A member of the [[Naberrie family]], she was a daughter of [[Ruwee Naberrie]] and [[Jobal Naberrie]], and the sister of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala]]. Sola had two daughters of her own, [[Ryoo Naberrie|Ryoo]] and [[Pooja Naberrie]], who were [[Reproduction|born]] during the [[Republic Era|last years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Sola Naberrie was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who was the [[Naberrie family|daughter]] of [[Ruwee Naberrie|Ruwee]] and [[Jobal Naberrie]], along with her younger sister, [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé]]. Sola and Padmé grew up together in the [[Naberrie family house]] on their [[homeworld]], [[Naboo]].<ref name="Queen's Shadow" /> When Padmé became [[Monarch of Naboo|queen]] of the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]], Padmé changed her last name from Naberrie to Amidala to protect Sola and her other loved ones. Amidala participated in the speech of choosing to be the Queen of Naboo as a [[hologram]] to Sola.<ref name="Queen's Peril" />

In [[28 BBY]],<ref name="28 BBY">In ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'', [[Padmé Amidala]] states that her sister has just had her first baby. The main story of the novel takes place 4 [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places in [[32 BBY]].</ref> choosing to [[Reproduction|have a child]] without a sexual partner. Sola gave birth to her first child, [[Ryoo Naberrie]]. After returning from a weeklong visit to [[Alderaan]], Amidala and several members of her entourage returned to Naboo and briefly met with Queen [[Réillata]] before visiting the family home, where Amidala met her niece for the first time.<ref name="Queen's Shadow" /> 

While Amidala was a senator from Naboo, Panaka made it a habit to occasionally visit the Naberrie family for lunch. During their visit, Ruwee engaged in a series of friendly but heated arguments with Panaka about Naboo's military actions. Ruwee began to understand [[Panaka]]'s beliefs, but did not agree with them, and Amidala's sister Sola always tried to leave before arguments turned into shouting. <ref name="Queen's Shadow" />

Sola also had another daughter, [[Pooja Naberrie|Pooja]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> As she didn't [[Marriage|marry]], Sola used her portion of the Naberrie family [[wedding fabric]] to make [[Clothing|clothes]] for her daughters, showing that she welcomed the new additions to the family.<ref name="Queen's Hope">''[[Queen's Hope]]''</ref>

Shortly before the [[Clone Wars]], Amidala visited the Naberries with her bodyguard, the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Family at War">''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]''</ref> Soon afterward, [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala|Amidala and Skywalker secretly married]].<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> The [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] was closely followed by Amidala's [[death]] after giving birth to the [[twin]]s [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Sola Naberrie was among the mourners who attended [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|her sister's funeral]] in the [[city]] of [[Theed]], alongside her [[parent]]s and her daughters.<ref name="Episode III" />

==Personality and traits==
Sola Naberrie was a human female who had light skin.<ref name="Episode III" /> Unlike her sister, Padmé, who desired a romantic relationship like the one their parents had, Sola was uninterested in having a partner, although she was comfortable with having children of her own.<ref name="Queen's Shadow" />

==Equipment==
Sola wore a dark [[Color|burgundy]] outfit with golden details to her sister's funeral, an outfit that closely resembled Amidala's wardrobe as a tribute. The dark tones of the costume reflected the sadness of the family and their mourning of her death.<ref name="The Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sola Naberrie was portrayed by [[Claudia Karvan]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/news20030829.html|text=Episode III Casting: Mother & Daughters}}</ref> She first appeared in a deleted scene from [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Deleted">{{Film|II}} {{Del}}</ref> She appears at the end of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] attending Padmé Amidala's funeral. The character's name is given in the film's closing credits.<ref name="Episode III" />

[[E. K. Johnston]], the author of ''[[Queen's Shadow]]'', confirmed that she intended Sola Naberrie to be both [[W:c:lgbtqia:Aromantic|aromantic]] and [[W:c:lgbtqia:Asexual|asexual]].<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=ekjohnston|url=post/190883221572/im-hearing-some-people-say-that-sola-naberrie-in|name=Words Words Words|text=I'm hearing some people say that Sola Naberrie in Queen's Shadow is aromantic, is this true?|quote=Aro and Ace. She decided she wanted a kid and so she got one. The healthcare system on Naboo is set up for that, and the social attitude leans heavily into 'none of your business'.}}</ref>
